notes:
# Page 150, scan 81

The leaf defines $V_J$ as the tubular pro-neighbourhood of $X_J^*$ in $X$, writes its union/limit expression (62), and introduces the **protopos** $V_J^L$ by (63). It gives the case $V_J^J=X_J^*$ in (64), defines the subsets $L_0$ and $J_0$, writes the four expressions of (65), and introduces the domination relation $J\prec L$ in (66). This is a statement of what the page says, not a verification of those equalities.

## Rereading driven by mathematical notation

- The ambiguity under lim prompted a reread of all of (62), including the stars, union index, two limit indices, and both argument subscripts. A small right-facing arrowhead is visible under lim; the candidate uses \varinjlim. No argument was supplied to decide it.
- In the marginal correction, the caret was traced independently of the surrounding inclusion mathematics. It connects the above-line K (idéal de J') to the cancelled J' in the inclusion. The later appearances of J' and the final X_K^* were checked individually and retained.
- Both ends of all three inclusion arrows in the left diagram were checked. The downward branch ends at a live V_J; the cancellation starts below that object.
- The canceled identity is now read with its L/L-prime superscripts and J/J-prime subscripts. The first raised L and initial NB remain locally uncertain; the earlier alternatives without superscripts are superseded by the final blind adjudication.
- The ideal/coideal paragraph prompted another comparison of the handwritten zero subscripts in the definitions and all four terms of (65). The visible indices are retained; no proof of (65) was attempted.
- The lower note's grammar would admit an est after J, but the ink has none. It is not supplied. The final isolated word remains uncertain between de and donc; neither ending is certified.

## State and apparatus

There is no live title and no date. The abandoned heading is struck. The number 36 at the top is in the author's dark writing; the thin light 80 at the bottom is a different foliation hand and is encoded as a marginal annotation, not \mspage. The current formula numbers are (62)–(66). Some number strokes, especially (62) and (65), are reinforced/overwritten; this page alone does not establish a prior numbering. H's statement about another cancelled page has not been adopted as source text.

The l/parenthesis issue after the first raised \subset L remains narrow: I first read the long curved stroke as the l and the following short high stroke as the apostrophe in l'ens. Root pointed out a possible closing parenthesis at the curved stroke. Re-viewing the same crop did not reveal an independent opening parenthesis. The candidate preserves the first reading and records the alternative ) l'ens; no opening delimiter is supplied.

The four tt forms are written as close two-stem ligatures and remain abbreviations. Both l'ens forms have no final stop. The final él. in the lower margin does have a stop. The prose equals sign in $J_0$ est = un idéal is explicit and retained, without expanding it to a word. No authorial question mark is visible; the remaining doubts are transcription doubts.

The line count is 35 textual/formula baselines: 22 in the main column (including the struck heading, displayed lines, and final de), 5 in the right example (including its inserted K line), 3 in the left prose note, 1 cancelled mathematical line under its diagram, and 4 in the lower-right note. The diagram's two object rows and the two isolated foliation numbers are inventoried separately, not counted as prose/formula baselines.

### Blind crop adjudication

The canceled header is Le cas ou V, with unaccented ou. The right cancellation is best read as one uncertain disposition, replacing the former two-word segmentation. The slanted canceled identity has L/L-prime superscripts and J/J-prime subscripts; its initial NB and first raised L remain uncertain. The label of (63) is unaccented def. The written mino- / rent line division is restored. Three certainty-only doubts are added for compressed element endings and the isolated de/donc fragment; the old certified de-versus-donc change is withdrawn. The arrow under lim in (62) is retained at medium confidence after full-formula reinspection. No mathematical test determined any of these readings.

The neutral boxes omit a short stretch between B17 and B18: ramené au cas de bandes dans la relation. It contains no disputed word, number, revision, or other mandatory blind target and was read in the complete first pass. B06 clips the tall f; the existing upper half was reopened to inspect the space above the label, without making a new crop.
